newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Elan Corp rated buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Elan Corp rated buy.

text.p: --Montgomery Securities analyst John Borzilleri said he initiated coverage of Elan Corp with a buy rating.
--He said he expects the company to earn $1.30 per share in 1996 and $1.60 per share in 1997. He has a 12 to 18 month target price of $36, which is about 29 percent above current levels.

--Elan is a diversified healthcare comany that makes pharmaceutical, diagnostic and medical nutritional products. Borzilleri said its 10 products in late-stage development makes it "poised for an era of sustained superior revenue and earnings growth."
